evidence: According to the XRD measurements, the Zr xTiyOz films were amorphous when grown at 250 °C. The films made at 300 °C were slightly crystallized (Figure 4). According to the peak positions, the crystalline phase was the orthorhombic ZrTiO4.49 In addition, there was a small shoulder at 25.2 °C which could be due to a small amount of TiO2 (anatase).
